{"script":"mkdir -p temp_checks
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_checks/initial_listing.txt
grep '/workspace$' temp_checks/initial_listing.txt > temp_checks/matches_raw.txt || true
: > temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -L "$p" ]; then type=symlink
  elif [ -f "$p" ]; then type=regular_file
  elif [ -d "$p" ]; then type=directory
  else type=other
  fi
  printf '%s|%s\n' "$p" "$type" >> temp_checks/matches_checked.txt
done < temp_checks/matches_raw.txt

: > temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt
awk -F'|' '{print $1 "|" $2}' temp_checks/matches_checked.txt | while IFS='|' read -r path type; do
  norm=$(readlink -f "$path" 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "$path")
  printf '%s|%s\n' "$norm" "$type"
done | awk -F'|' '!seen[$1]++ {print $1 "|" $2}' > temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt

if awk -F'|' '$2=="regular_file"{exit 0} END{exit 1}' temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt; then
  echo true > temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag
  ans=yes
else
  echo false > temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag
  ans=no
fi

{
  echo "found_regular_file: $(cat temp_checks/found_regular_file.flag)"
  echo "matches_normalized:"
  cat temp_checks/matches_normalized.txt
} > temp_checks/summary.txt

echo "$ans""}
